opportunities.name: Lightning AP ramp
opportunities.objective: Turn AP into passive attack cadence as well as lightning damage.
opportunities.mechanic: Each passive stack grants attack speed with an AP term, up to five stacks, then attacks add AP-scaled chain lightning. Nashor and Rageblade test the attack phase; E has an AP/health shield for staying close, and Riftmaker rewards extended contact. Terminus supports mixed physical/magic attacks after ramp.
opportunities.requiredState: Five earned passive stacks and attack access; Rageblade/Terminus ramps recorded separately.
opportunities.failure: Stacks expire during kiting or low durability prevents reaching full attack ramp.
opportunities.test: Count passive stacks, attack intervals and lightning packets before and after five stacks, with phantom hits isolated.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Chain lightning does not prove extra targets receive Nashor or every on-hit effect.

opportunities.name: Wounded mark revisit
opportunities.objective: Prioritize reaching a second W on the same marked target.
opportunities.mechanic: W's mark lasts eight seconds; recast gains a damage multiplier involving AD and heals missing health. Shojin basic haste and Trinity spell-followed attacks support repeat contact, Bloodmail supplies health-derived AD and Visage strengthens W healing/E shielding. Q stun buys time for the initial setup.
opportunities.requiredState: Same target remains marked, current health/AD recorded and W returns before mark expiry.
opportunities.failure: Target swapping forfeits the heal or crowd control denies the second cast.
opportunities.test: Log first versus marked W damage/heal at matched missing health and changing AD; measure actual revisit time.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The helper labeled Thundering Smash containing R text is not a second Q or R damage source.

ruledOut.reason: W's missing-health heal is described for using it on an already marked target.

unknowns: Passive chain inheritance, W raw bonus-health/AD terms and the obsolete mislabeled helper need live source reconciliation.

builds.name: Lightning AP ramp
builds.summary: Turn AP into passive attack cadence as well as lightning damage.
builds.goal: Turn AP into passive attack cadence as well as lightning damage.
builds.hypothesis: Each passive stack grants attack speed with an AP term, up to five stacks, then attacks add AP-scaled chain lightning. Nashor and Rageblade test the attack phase; E has an AP/health shield for staying close, and Riftmaker rewards extended contact. Terminus supports mixed physical/magic attacks after ramp.
testPlan: Required state: Five earned passive stacks and attack access; Rageblade/Terminus ramps recorded separately.
Count passive stacks, attack intervals and lightning packets before and after five stacks, with phantom hits isolated.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Stacks expire during kiting or low durability prevents reaching full attack ramp.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Chain lightning does not prove extra targets receive Nashor or every on-hit effect.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Terminus, Riftmaker, Rabadon's Deathcap, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
